🇩🇪 A1 GERMAN VOCABULARY: Kleidung (Clothes)

die Socke = sock
die Mütze = hat/cap
der Hut = hat
der Gürtel = belt
die Hose = trousers
das Hemd = shirt

💡 Tip: Learn der/die/das with every noun.
